name: ZCA_UA_CLICK_MAPPING_B
description: Table to store the meaningful mapping of click event

columns.name: CLICK_MAPPING_ID
columns.description: Column to store the Primary Key of the Click Mapping Table

columns.name: CH_EVENT_COMP_CLIENT_CODE
columns.description: Column to store the UI component click id associated with the click event

columns.name: CLICK_PATTERN
columns.description: Column to store the regex pattern for the component click id

columns.name: CLICK_EVENT_TYPE
columns.description: Column to store the click event type

columns.name: CLICK_TYPE
columns.description: Click type associated with the click event

columns.name: CLICK_REGION_VIEW_ID
columns.description: Column to store the task flow associated with the click event

columns.name: CLICK_RVD_PATTERN
columns.description: Column to store the regex pattern for the region view id

columns.name: CLICK_EVENT_DISPLAY_TEXT
columns.description: Column to store the meaningful display text for the click event

columns.name: CLICK_EVENT_FLOW_NAME
columns.description: Column to store the flow name associated with the click event

columns.name: CLICK_EVENT_DISPLAY_DESC
columns.description: Column to store the description text associated with the click event

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
